description: 三篇示例文章，每篇一张 AI 原创情境插画、一张可复用的网络图片。

images.description: 原创 AI 情境插画，不是实拍、真实系统截图或作者个人经历的还原。
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one wide landscape editorial illustration for the Chinese blog essay 'Interfaces as epistemic partners', target 16:9, roughly 1440 pixels wide.
Primary request: depict a digital interface as a place where an anonymous adult researcher can compare evidence and revise a question. A quiet desk near a window, a laptop viewed obliquely, several small physical paper evidence cards and two lightly transparent abstract interface panels echoing those cards. The person, seen from behind and occupying only a small part of the scene, gently repositions one card to explore a different explanation; the composition suggests an open path of inquiry instead of a single final answer.
Style/medium: refined editorial gouache and colored pencil on warm lightly textured ivory paper, painterly rather than corporate vector.
Composition: spacious horizontal framing, clear hierarchy, restrained detail and breathing room; the relationship between papers, person and screen is the focal point. Consistent with a thoughtful personal research blog.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, quiet curiosity, provisional and open.
Color palette: slate blue, muted teal, warm ivory, tiny amber accent.
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no equations, no legible code, no branding, no identifiable person or institution; any marks on paper/screens are sparse abstract line shapes. A conceptual illustration, not a screenshot or research result.
Avoid: robots, glowing brains, sci-fi hologram spectacle, generic corporate vector people, glossy 3D, neon, decorative border, watermark.

images.description: 原创 AI 情境插画，不是实拍、真实系统截图或作者个人经历的还原。
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one wide landscape editorial illustration for the Chinese blog essay 'Calibrating trust in AI assistance', target 16:9, roughly 1440 pixels wide.
Primary request: a close, calm view of an anonymous adult's workspace during careful verification: a modest laptop with a few abstract suggestion cards on its screen, an open notebook with sparse abstract marks, two source pages laid side by side, and a hand using a pencil to connect a small piece of evidence on paper. A simple analog measuring instrument sits quietly at the edge of the desk as a visual echo of calibration, not a chart or technical diagram. Emphasize choosing when to verify before relying on a suggestion.
Style/medium: refined editorial gouache and colored pencil on warm lightly textured ivory paper, with clear shapes and soft painterly edges.
Composition: wide and intimate, viewed from a slightly elevated angle; papers and checking gesture are focal, face outside frame, generous breathing room, visually coherent with a personal research blog.
Lighting/mood: gentle desk-lamp glow mixed with blue-gray ambient light, deliberate, thoughtful, grounded.
Color palette: slate blue, muted teal, warm ivory, restrained amber.
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no percentages, no equations, no code, no logos, no identifiable person. Do not depict an actual tested system or real scientific result. Any marks are sparse abstract strokes.
Avoid: humanoid robots, robot-human handshake, glowing brains, sci-fi, neon, glossy 3D, fake detailed UI, motivational symbols, border, watermark.

images.description: 原创 AI 情境插画，不是实拍、真实系统截图或作者个人经历的还原。
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one wide landscape editorial illustration for the Chinese reflective essay 'The quiet work of attention', target 16:9, roughly 1440 pixels wide.
Primary request: the quiet pause after reading a page: an anonymous adult seen in a small three-quarter back view sits beside an open book at a simple desk near a window, momentarily still, noticing a slow patch of afternoon sunlight and delicate leaf shadows on an unadorned wall. A phone lies face down near the far edge of the desk. Nothing dramatic is happening; the light, room and attentive pause carry the image.
Style/medium: refined editorial gouache and colored pencil on warm lightly textured ivory paper, painterly, understated and humane.
Composition: wide horizontal view with ample calm negative space on the wall; person and book occupy a modest part of the frame, subtle texture, few objects.
Lighting/mood: late afternoon, tender and reflective without sentimentality, a lived-in ordinary room.
Color palette: warm ivory sunlight, slate blue shadows, muted teal accent, very little amber.
Constraints: no readable text on book or anywhere, no lettering, no logos, no identifiable real person or place; this is a conceptual scene for a sample essay, not the author's personal memory.
Avoid: elaborate luxury interior, excessive plants, glossy 3D, generic corporate vector style, neon, motivational icons, ornamental frame, watermark.
